verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of Mixpanel's identity resolution mechanics (e.g., identify/alias APIs, $device_id vs $user_id merging pre-signup anonymous activity into an identified profile). Only an indirect community reference to an 'identify-users guide' exists, with no substantive detail on cross-device merge behavior. Missing for 10: official docs on identify()/alias() API, cross-device merge semantics, and any independent confirmation the merge works reliably.
